جُبَّأٌ (S, K) and ↓ جُبَّاءٌ? (Sb, K) Fearful, or cowardly: (S, K:) fem. with ة: and therefore the pl. is formed by the addition of و and ن.
(Sb, TA.) Mafrook Ibn-' Amr Esh-Sheybánee says, “فَمَا أَنَ مِنْ رَيْبِ المَنُونِ بِجُبَّأٍ
وَلَا أَنَا مِنْ سَيْبِ الإِلٰهِ بِآيِسِ
” [But I am not fearful of the vicissitudes of fortune, nor despairing of the favour of God]. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
